verdict.rationale: Cooley GO's self-serve features are template document generators and a quarterly financing-data report, and none is described as AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's own data. Cooley AI is described as helping the firm's lawyers deliver faster insights, and the S-1 prompt drafting is a firm-side drafting workflow. Neither is a documented in-product capability that analyzes a user's data, so this is an adjacent feature rather than the story's capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
